title: Diabetes coverage.
bodyText: All group health care contracts under this chapter shall provide, to the extent provided under section 431:10A-121, coverage for outpatient diabetes self-management training, education, equipment, and supplies.
bodyHtml: [§432:1-612]  Diabetes coverage.  All group health care contracts under this chapter shall provide, to the extent provided under section 431:10A-121, coverage for outpatient diabetes self-management training, education, equipment, and supplies. [L 2000, c 243, §3]
